title: TractionCurrentMeasurementUncertaintyBudget
description: Comprehensive GUM (JCGM 100:2008) compliant measurement uncertainty budget for motor stator phase current de-energization and persistence timing on AGV-RES-TRUCK-01.

measurement_components.description: Current probe and amplifier calibration uncertainty (ISO/IEC 17025 accredited certificate)
Residual Hall-effect DC zero offset after manual de-gaussing and front-panel balance nulling
Inverter DC bus switching EMI and laboratory ambient optical/inductive noise floor
Oscilloscope 8-bit vertical digitizer resolution at 100 mV/div (0.1 V/A scale)
Sliding RMS numerical integration discretization over finite 2.0 ms window (2000 samples)
Thermal sensitivity of Hall sensor over ambient operating range (15 deg C to 35 deg C)
Hardware 4th-order low-pass filter passband ripple and transient overshoot

current_amplitude_uncertainty_budget.decision_rule: I_motor_RMS(t) <= (0.500 A - 0.087 A) = 0.413 A RMS to guarantee 95.45% confidence of true current < 0.500 A RMS

measurement_components.description: Keysight DSO crystal oscillator timebase clock jitter and drift
Sliding RMS filter group delay uncertainty (symmetric Hann/rectangular kernel)
Sliding evaluation step size (0.1 ms step discretization uncertainty)
E-Stop push button dry contact break chattering and threshold trigger jitter

timing_latency_uncertainty_budget.decision_rule: delta_t_electrical_traction <= (50.0 ms - 1.2 ms) = 48.8 ms with U = 1.2 ms conservative guard band
